sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Belatucadros is a Continental Celtic god. His other name is Belatucadros. He is an obscure Gaulish deity. His name means beautiful in slaughter, or fair slayer. The Romans compared him with their war god Mars. He left many small dedications across northwestern England. This evidence shows that the lowly soldiers most favored his cult. He never appears with a female partner. His worship was simple and not elaborate.

okr.objective: Belatucadros is a Gaulish god of war honored in small religious sites by Roman-rank soldiers.
